draft:
Hi Priya,

Thank you for contacting SkyVault Support about "Refund for my new monthly plan". Your message has been passed to our Billing team, who will review it and reply to you directly.

For reference, this is the relevant part of our published refund policy:

"A new monthly subscription can be refunded in full if the refund is requested within 14 days of the first payment. Monthly renewal payments are not refundable. You can cancel at any time and keep access until the end of the current billing period."

Best regards,
SkyVault Support

Best regards, SkyVault Support

Since your annual plan was renewed three months ago, it is outside the 30-day window for a full refund. After this period, annual plans remain active until their term ends and are not refundable. Support agents cannot approve refunds directly; only the Billing team handles these requests after review. We have passed your request to them. Best regards, SkyVault Support

Hi Oliver,

To change your account email, go to Settings > Account > Email and enter your new Gmail address. A confirmation link will be sent there; the change takes effect once you open that link. Please note the link expires after 24 hours.

Best regards, SkyVault Support
